title: Localized pointwise a posteriori error estimates for nonconforming finite element methods
summary: This paper establishes the first localized pointwise a posteriori error estimates for nonconforming finite element discretizations of the Poisson and biharmonic equations. For the Poisson problem, we derive localized estimates for the function-value and broken gradient errors of the Crouzeix--Raviart method. For the Morley discretization of the biharmonic equation, we derive a localized a posteriori estimate that controls the local Hessian error.
